# ASC/AC Store

> > Official store of the American Society of Cinematographers (ASC) and American Cinematographer magazine, offering professional cinematography equipment, magazine issues, and fine art photography by ASC members.

The ASC/AC Store serves the cinematography community by providing access to professional light meters and equipment from brands like Sekonic, back issues of American Cinematographer magazine covering major film and television productions, and limited edition archival photography prints by renowned cinematographers including members of ASC, BSC, GSC, and other international cinematography societies.

## Key Topics

- American Society of Cinematographers (ASC)
- American Cinematographer magazine
- Professional cinematography equipment
- Sekonic light meters
- ASC member photography
- Limited edition archival prints
- Virtual production coverage
- Film and television cinematography
- International cinematography societies (BSC, GSC, ACS, ACK)
- Star Wars cinematography
- Cine Gear Expo
- Fine art photography by cinematographers
- Professional grip and lighting equipment

## Professional Cinematography Equipment

- [Sekonic C 800 Spectromaster](https://store.ascmag.com/products/sekonic-c-800-spectromaster): Sekonic C-800 full-spectrum color meter for LED, HMI & fluorescent lights
- [The Sekonic SpeedMaster L-858D-U](https://store.ascmag.com/products/the-sekonic-speedmaster-l-858d-u): Sekonic SpeedMaster L-858D-U multi-function light meter with touchscreen
- [Pro Leather Black Glove](https://store.ascmag.com/products/pro-leather-black-glove): Heat-resistant leather glove for lighting, rigging & grip professionals
- [EZ-Fit Glove](https://store.ascmag.com/products/ez-fit-glove): EZ-Fit multipurpose work glove with synthetic leather & padded palm

- [2022/ 08 -August Issue of American Cinematographer](https://store.ascmag.com/products/august-2022-issue-of-american-cinematographer): Aug 2022 American Cinematographer featuring Rising Stars & virtual production
- [2023/05 May Issue of American Cinematographer](https://store.ascmag.com/products/may-2023-issue-of-american-cinematographer): May 2023 American Cinematographer with Chevalier & 37th ASC Awards coverage
